Get and load safedata metadata

Source: R/metadata.R
fetch_record_metadata.Rd

Internal handlers to:

Usage

fetch_record_metadata(record_set)

load_record_metadata(record_set)

Arguments

record_set

An object of class safe_record_set.

Value

The fetch_record_metadata function invisibly returns a logical value indicating if all records were fetched successfully and load_record_metadata returns a list object containing record metadata

Details

  1. ensure there are local copies of record metadata, fetching it using the safedata_server API if needed and

  2. load thatdata from file.

This is the same metadata used to populate the Zenodo description but is downloaded as JSON format and stored within the record directory in the safedata directory for reuse.

Functions

  • fetch_record_metadata(): Download and store JSON metadata for a record

  • load_record_metadata(): Load JSON metadata for a record

Examples

   # \donttest{
     rec <- validate_record_ids(1400562)
     safedata:::fetch_record_metadata(rec)
     metadata <- safedata:::load_record_metadata(rec)
#> No response from server, skipping updates: http://example.safedata.server
#> Loading and caching index
#> Validating directory
   # }
